purpose: Show file metadata with a raster image lightbox or a safe document fallback and optional download link.
behaviorProvider: Native image/link elements and shared Modal for image lightbox focus/dismissal.

component: image failure fallback and lightbox composition
host: download response headers and blob lifetime
accessible image description and file availability

requirements.statement: Render inline previews only for PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, AVIF and BMP MIME types with an allowed URL. Use native img; do not execute or embed HTML, SVG, PDF or office documents.
Reject control characters, executable/file protocols and non-raster data URLs. Permit relative, HTTP(S), blob URLs and base64 raster data URLs; suppress both image and download for rejected URLs.
Render file name and MIME/date metadata as text in a definition list. Format nonnegative safe-integer byte counts in binary units and reject invalid numeric sizes.
After the thumbnail reports an image-load error, show the fallback status and omit the image-preview action for that URL while retaining an allowed download link.
Open supported images through the shared Modal with the file name as title and Image preview description, delegating modal focus management, Escape and close behavior.
When enabled and URL is permitted, render a native download link with the supplied file name and the shared external-link isolation behavior. Download=false removes that action.

Supply authorized URLs and correct MIME/size metadata. Revoke object URLs when no longer used and serve documents with appropriate Content-Type, Content-Disposition and origin policy; URL classification is not content inspection.
Provide imageAlt that describes meaningful image content when the file name alone is insufficient, and supply any already-formatted modification date explicitly.
Use data-display group tokens for the file surface. Nested Button, Link and Modal retain their own category token ownership.

limitations: PDFs and all non-raster documents use metadata/download fallback; no document parsing or browser PDF embedding is provided.
Cross-origin download behavior is controlled by browser and response headers; the download attribute is not a guarantee.
The URL policy is not malware scanning, content verification, DRM or an authorization boundary.
